docs.summary: The resolved input to a bake: an agent type's physical envelope plus the surface-level rasterization overrides, composed by [`GetBuildSettings`](#api~Prowl.Runtime.NavMeshAgentTypes~GetBuildSettings). A baked [`NavMeshData`](#api~Prowl.Runtime.NavMeshData) keeps a snapshot, so later edits to the agent table or the surface do not change what an existing navmesh was built with.

Largest tile size a navmesh can represent: compressed layer headers store the layer's grid dimensions in a byte, and a wider tile wraps to an empty layer, a navmesh with no polygons at all from a bake that reported success.
Tile size used when nothing is overridden. Carving re-contours a whole tile, so tile size is the per-carve cost and the default stays well under the cap.
The agent type this navmesh is built for. Agents only use navmeshes of their own type.
The physical envelope voxelized for: radius, height, slope and climb.
Voxel and tile sizes, region culling and Recast filtering.
The XZ voxel size actually used: the override, or a third of the agent radius.
The voxel height actually used (half the XZ voxel size).
The tile side length in voxels actually used. A bake stores the resolved value back into its overrides, so a baked asset always reports what was really used.
Snapshot copy, so a bake is not mutated by later edits.
